Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
Hi
Just a quick question about Libertas.
If blocking anarch vampire with libertas atempts to block a Govern
bleed. Does the Govern bleed cost an additional blood, or was it
played before the block attempt and therefor it is not affected by the
Libertas?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Libertas doesn't affect the cost of action cards. The cost is not paid while the
Libertas anarch is attempting to block.

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:


The latter. And, as precedented by Blessing of Chaos, the acting
vampire can play dominate and presence modifiers at normal cost before
the Libertas vamp can even attempt to block.
